title: Bleaching – Synchronization C. elegans
author: Oscar Carrillo
materials: Repetir el lavado nuevamente por 2 ocasiones más.
Descartar sobrenadante sin mover el pellet de embriones.

steps.title: Wash worms with cold M9
steps.instruction: Wash worms and embryos with cold M9, recover them from the Petri dishes and transfer the suspension into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant carefully without disturbing the worm/embryo pellet.

steps.title: Add bleaching solution
steps.instruction: Add 6 mL of bleaching solution to the tube (after the last wash) and gently invert the tube for 4 minutes, constantly checking that adult worm bodies are dissolving and not exceeding 4 minutes.

steps.title: Stop bleaching with M9
steps.instruction: Add excess cold M9 to stop the bleaching reaction, bringing the total volume up to 15 mL.

steps.title: Centrifuge pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 3000 rpm for 1 minute with the 15 mL of M9.

steps.title: Wash pellet five times
steps.instruction: Perform five additional washes with cold M9:

substeps.instruction: Add M9 to the pellet (volume sufficient to resuspend).
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend final pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 1 mL of cold M9.

steps.title: Count embryos (triplicate)
steps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the suspension, place it on a slide (portaobjeto) and count the number of embryos; repeat this counting in triplicate.

steps.title: Incubate with shaking
steps.instruction: Place the tube on its side at 20 °C and incubate with rotary shaking at 120 rpm.

steps.title: Count L1 larvae next day
steps.instruction: The following day, count the number of L1-stage worms present in the solution.
